text: Price for the sale of Tribal Group businesses to Main Capital Partners increased from approximately £189.3 million to approximately £231.2 million. Irrevocable undertakings to vote in favour of the sale amount to 52.7%
DNO confirms that its cash offer of US$5.214 per share is final and it will not be increased
Publication of Scheme Document by Veritas. The Court and General Meetings will be held on 21 October 2026
Deletion: CVC Advisers Limited confirms it does not intend to make an offer for Bodycote
Deletion: Termination of Formal Sale Process. Checkit had received non-binding offers from three potential acquirers. However, none materialised.
Shareholders overwhelmingly approve the scheme. The effective date is scheduled for 9 October 2026.
New HF entrant: Carmignac crosses 1% (1.07%, all derivatives).
